text:
Dana: Quick post-launch huddle 3m  We need 3 focused follow-up slices for the next 2 sprints that are low-risk and have clear rollback plans. Ideas? :wave:

Leo: I'll nominate: (1) API 429 retry/backoff + idempotency header, (2) streaming client shows progress heartbeat + lightweight retry affordance, (3) small safety toggle revert for an embed postprocess that increased hallucinations for a few customers.

Priya: +1. For (3) we should absolutely per-org canary the revert. No wide flip. Route 5-10% traffic for 48h, compare precision metrics and user feedback.

Kim: Owners + quick estimates: 1) 6h (edge patch + tests), 2) 3h (UX + docs), 3) 1.5-2d (ML + canary gating). Also add a backlog hygiene ticket to require a "rollback plan" checkbox on post-launch PRs.

Dana: Draft acceptance criteria (ACs):
- API retry: "post-deploy <1% 429s per org over 24h; p99 latency delta <20%; synthetic probe passes."
- Streaming heartbeat: "shows last-chunk timestamp; after 7s show 'retry' CTA; accessibility tested."
- Embed revert: "per-org eval shows >=3pt uplift in precision@5 or abort and revert promoted."

Leo: Ops guardrail: if p95 latency increases >25% during canary OR error-rate doubles, auto-abort. Also synthetic tests hitting retry path every 30s.

Priya: I'll run the grooming Loom + rubric (impact, rollback complexity, infra touch) and add the rollback checkbox to the PR template. Will post in ~2 hours.

CanaryBot: [canary] Canary job queued for API retry patch. Window=2h. Auto-rollback thresholds configured (p99 + error-rate).

Kim: Who picks what? I can own streaming heartbeat + docs. Leo take the API retry? Priya own grooming + rollback checklist? Dana coordinate embed canary with ML infra?

Leo: I'll take the API retry and the canary orchestration pairing with Ops. I'll add the QA harness for idempotency checks.

Priya: Yep I'll own grooming. I'll publish the rubric and a 45m async session so folks can drop comments. Also will add a short checklist: required metrics, synth tests, rollback steps, owners.

Dana: I'll coordinate embed canary with ML infra and compile per-org eval sets. @Leo drop a template for the canary alert thresholds into the ticket so we can automate rollback.

Leo: Will do. Template example: "abort if p95 latency +25% or error-rate >2x baseline for 15m". Also include a stop-gap manual rollback step in case automation misses something.

Kim: Timeline targets: API retry (1 day), streaming heartbeat (0.5 day), embed canary (2 days). I'll create sprint slices and tag owners. If anyone thinks timelines are unrealistic, flag here within 6h. :thumbsup:
